name: wraith
description: Wraith (red team) + Aegis (blue team) — two independent, self-contained cybersecurity agents for pi, with a one-command installer. Each ships its own persona, team-specific tools, and its own slice of the offline workflow library (447 offensive skills for Wraith, 370 defensive for Aegis; Nmap, Burp, sqlmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Sliver, Volatility, Sigma, YARA, Splunk, ...). Built for Kali Linux.
